svg.title: Mercator and Equal Earth world map comparison
svg.desc: Two world maps use the same Natural Earth country-boundary data. The Mercator map visually enlarges high-latitude regions and visually shrinks equatorial Africa. The Equal Earth map preserves relative area, making Africa much larger than Greenland.
svg.text: Same Earth. A different measurement choice.

g.text: same boundary data · relative areas preserved

svg.text: DATA: NATURAL EARTH 1:110M ADMIN 0 COUNTRIES · PROJECTIONS: WEB MERCATOR / EQUAL EARTH · OMOLUABI 2026
